objective.name: shadow_bottle
objective.definition: Sum of squared native digit landing, body contact, mesh penetration, fingertip separation, table/pregrasp clearance and pair-specific joint coordination residuals.
objective.chart: The same pair-specific objective evaluated along the physical replay in the moving object frame; time is simulation time, not solver iterations.
objective.orientation: Side cylindrical wrap of the shared bottle

provenance.execution: Offline MuJoCo free-object contact replay. Native finger actuators and dynamic wrist control; no object attachment or object-pose commands after reset. Native arm IK with table clearance.
provenance.grasp_selection: Independent hand/object objective with complete cross-finger clearance; bottle additionally enforces four fingertips in one half-space and thumb in the opposite half-space.
provenance.geometry: Original simulation duck visual and all 16 collision parts, 125 x 92.6556 x 102.5779 mm, rigid 180-degree yaw only. Bottle geometry remains identical for all hands.
provenance.loss: The same pair-specific objective evaluated along the physical replay in the moving object frame; time is simulation time, not solver iterations.
provenance.scope: Local simulation preview pending visual acceptance. No hardware or benchmark claim.
